summary: This bill requires public elementary and secondary schools to disclose to the Secretary of Education, within 30 days, any funds exceeding $10,000 received from or contracts exceeding $10,000 with a foreign source as a condition for receiving federal financial assistance.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts public elementary and secondary schools by imposing conditions on their receipt of federal funds related to foreign funding. While it doesn't directly increase or decrease overall spending, it sets a new rule for how schools can operate to maintain their funding, making it moderately relevant to education policy.
